Existing forehead helmets/bands remain above the new exposed alien face. Relaxed neutral guard/civilian stance and gently partly open four mandibles, no new fighting action. Do not copy photographic background, black vest, logo, watermark or any other photo element. Deliver ONE complete full-body sprite on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha, same portrait canvas composition, whole head, feet and every piece of carried equipment visible with clear margins.
